description:
Beautiful Unofficial YouTube Music desktop app that includes several customizations for users and developers.

Unofficial YouTube Music desktop client for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Features Discord Rich Presence, custom themes, Last.fm scrobbling, tray view,
Stream Deck support, local API, OBS overlays, and ytmd:// shared links.
## Changes

• fix(windows)：return focus to parent when a sub window closes (0c2e3ea)
• chore：ignore *.local.* files (b60afee)
• feat(settings)：grouped-list settings UI with advanced folds (b7c4fa9)
• fix(queue-continue)：stop re-requesting an empty or failed continuation (3b84551)
• fix(discord)：clear presence after idle pause and rewrite IPC client (a43d786)
• fix(startup)：remove unconditional power save blocker preventing system sleep (36e5ad3)
• feat(docs)：force dark theme and remove theme switch (0e7879b)
• feat(docs)：redesign landing page to match biyori docs (f9f8379)
• feat(queue-continue)：add queue continuation setting and enhance parsing logic (ec7f52d)
• feat(queue-continue)：implement queue continuation functionality with parsing and rendering (29f5bdc)
• style(globals)：add button to non-selectable elements (5e0e206)
• style(globals)：enhance text selection behavior across elements (4633d2b)
• fix(tray-view)：queue list scrollbar not showing on blurred window mouseenter (2e23e04)
• fix(tray-view)：improve window always-on-top behavior & queue loading behaviour (45c52f2)
• fix(tray-view)：window focus behavior (4182d6f)
